## Example contract

Complete this section when adding or changing an application example.

- [ ] The workflow is meaningful and end to end, not an isolated feature snippet.
- [ ] The example is complete within one top-level folder.
- [ ] It has no runtime, build, or code dependency on root files or sibling examples.
- [ ] It owns its README, dependency manifest, lockfile, definitions, code, and
  tests.
- [ ] Start, reset, maintenance, and debugging instructions are verified.
- [ ] Docker or local infrastructure is included when needed.
- [ ] Released Determa State dependencies are pinned.
- [ ] No shared root dependency manifest or shared application code was added.
- [ ] No unsupported execution CLI or socket capability is claimed.
